description: This file contains utility functions for error handling within the 'interactors' package, specifically for evaluating existing errors and checking multiple errors.

methods.name: ExistingErrorOr
methods.description: Returns the existing error if it is not nil; otherwise, executes and returns the error from the provided function.

methods.name: AnyError
methods.description: Iterates over a list of errors and returns the first non-nil error encountered; returns nil if all errors are nil.
